title: 第六百一十五章 杀入守钥星第六百一十四章 古佛苏醒半步十五级
lines: 守钥星周围的星域之中。
几艘以白色为底，表面交织着金色纹路的星舰正按照固定的路线巡逻。
守钥星上虽然被交战双方布置了重重阵法，秘法，甚至还有些不可言说的诡秘手段，但仍旧不能说完全保险。无论是神域，还是星空巨人一族，都还是会时不时地派部队过来巡逻。
巡逻过程中，自然也免不了会碰上对方的巡逻部队，所以，小范围的摩擦自然也是时常发生的。
不过，这种小范围的摩擦通常来说都闹不大，两边动起手来也相对克制，巡逻队的心态自然也不会太紧张。
为首的旗舰内，两个穿着华丽银铠的天使正坐在指挥椅上，悠闲地聊着天。
“你说神国这段时间是不是发生什么事情了？几位主神和神王都有一阵子没出现了。”坐在首位上的银发天使端着杯红酒，表情困惑，“要不是我问了熟悉的主神，知道神国内一切安稳，我都要怀疑神王是不是出事了。”
“大概是神王陛下又有什么计划了吧~”另一个天使正捧着本书在看，闻言不是很在意回了一句，“就算真有事，我们这些小人物也就只有听令行事的份。老大，你想那么多做什么？”
“你懂个屁！”银发天使没好气地白了他一眼，“什么都不知道，万一被人坑去送死怎么办？你忘了几百年前那次坤堡之役了吗？圣乐之主是怎么死的？不就是被坑死的吗？”
“行行行~你有理行了吧~别耽误我看书。”另一个天使说着又翻了一页，“这本叫《保护我方族长》的书还挺有意思的。下次让下面人多送几本这样的书上来，接下来这段时间驻防也就不无聊了。”
“真那么好看？”银发天使被他说得也好奇了，“给我也看看。”
两人正聊着，下面正操作星舰的天使之中有一个忽然表情骤变：“舰长，敌袭！”
银发天使不以为意地瞟了那边一眼，连手里的红酒都没放下：“又是哪里来的小喽啰？那帮星空巨人还没吃够亏吗？”
“不，不是。”小天使脸色发白，连声音都是抖的，“是黑铁之堡！”
说话间，他已经抖着手把仪器探查到的画面投到了公屏上。
只见深邃幽寂的星空背景之下，一尊仿如钢铁巨兽一般的庞然大物正以一种可怕的速度急速逼近。
那是一座巨大的堡垒！
一座，他们所有人都无比熟悉的黝黑色堡垒，黑铁之堡！
跟停泊时的情况不同，此刻的黑铁之堡已经收起了基座，停泊平台，以及所有不必要的设施，侧面打开了巨大的青铜侧翼，就如同一艘巨大的星空母舰一般在星空中疾速飙飞。
画面里没有声音，但那庞然大物周围激荡的能量浪潮，扭曲的空间裂缝，以及那几乎要化为流星碎光的背景，已经充分表明了它的声势有多恐怖。
旁边监测数据上，正以可怕速度疯狂缩短的星程数字，更是充分表明了黑铁之堡此刻的速度有多惊人。
银发天使手里的酒杯“哐当”一声摔在了地上，碎了。
他怎么不知道，黑铁之堡居然还能当战舰用呢？！黑铁之堡可是通体用青铜铸造的，硬度无与伦比，这要撞上来，他的星舰还玩屁啊？！
其实也不能怪他不知道，其实连星空巨人自己都快忘记黑铁之堡这个功能了。毕竟，黑铁之堡上一次使用这个功能已经是几百万年前了，大概也就只有世代驻守黑铁之堡的纳特家族，仍然记得黑铁之堡最初的用法。
而这，也是所有青铜战舰的基础用法。
可惜，他现在才知道，已经晚了。
就在银发天使反应过来，惊怒大吼着让手下调转方向，想要避开黑铁之堡的时候，黑铁之堡已经呼啸着划破虚空，直接撞了上来。
震耳欲聋的轰鸣声瞬间响彻虚空。
神域的巡逻星舰在整个星际范围内都算是最顶尖的科技水准了，但在黑铁之堡可怕的威势面前，却几乎毫无抵抗之力地就被撞扁，撞飞了。
锋利的青铜侧翼划过星舰，星舰就像是纸糊的一样，几乎是顷刻间就被切成了两半。
舰内的天使四散飞出，想要在混乱中博一线生机，却连几千米的距离都没能飞出，就不受控制地被黑铁之堡周围激荡的能量浪潮卷了进去，很快就被狂暴的能量撕扯成了碎片。
其实黑铁之堡还真不是专门冲着神域巡逻队来的。怪只怪，这巡逻队运气不好，居然偏偏撞到了黑铁之堡的航线上。
巨大的黑色堡垒呼啸而过，就像是碾碎了一颗无关紧要的小石子一样，没有一丝停顿地就朝着前方继续疾驰而去。
待能量乱流渐渐平息，原地，便只剩下了一片片扭曲散乱的战舰残骸徐徐飘散，丝毫看不出它们原本的形貌。
而这时候，黑铁之堡在经过不断加速之后，也终于抵达了守钥星的护卫禁制外围。
感受到不断逼近的威势，布置在守钥星外围的圣光护盾自动自发地层层展开，圣洁的光盾有如鳞片般层叠交错，化为了一片光的海洋。
这是由神域十三位十四级主神联手布下的“光之壁垒”，其防御力极其强大，足以抵御一位十五级强者的全力一击。
然而，黑铁之堡在此之前早已将速度催化到极致，近乎于光速的可怕速度加成之下，这座巨大的金属堡垒俨然已经变成了一尊无与伦比的大杀器。
一个“光之壁垒”，哪里挡得住？

…
In the star field around the Key Keeper Star.
Several starships with a white background and golden patterns intertwined on the surface are patrolling along fixed routes.
Although the warring parties on the Key Keeper Star have deployed many formations, secret techniques, and even some unspeakable secret methods, it still cannot be said to be completely safe. Whether it's the God's Domain or the Starry Sky Giants, they will still send troops to patrol from time to time.
During the patrol, it is inevitable to encounter the opponent's patrol troops, so small-scale frictions naturally occur from time to time.
However, this kind of small-scale friction is usually not serious, and both sides are relatively restrained in their actions. Naturally, the mentality of the patrol team is not too nervous.
In the leader's flagship, two angels in gorgeous silver armor were sitting on command chairs, chatting leisurely.
"Do you think something has happened in the Kingdom of God during this time? The main gods and the God King have not appeared for a while." The silver-haired angel sitting at the head of the table was holding a glass of red wine with a confused expression. "If I hadn't asked the familiar Lord God and found out that everything was stable in the Kingdom of God, I would have doubted whether something happened to the God King."
"Maybe His Majesty the God King has some plans~" Another angel was holding a book and reading. Hearing the words, he didn't care much and replied, "Even if something really happens, we little people can only obey orders. Boss, what do you want to do so much?"
"You know nothing!" The silver-haired angel rolled his eyes at him angrily, "You don't know anything, what if you are tricked into dying? Have you forgotten the battle of Kunbao hundreds of years ago? How did the Lord of Holy Music die? Wasn't he just tricked to death?"
"Okay, okay~ You are reasonable, right~ Don't delay my reading." Another angel said and turned another page. "This book called "Protect Our Patriarch" is quite interesting. Next time, let the people below send more books like this, so that the garrison will not be boring during the next period."
"Is it really that beautiful?" The silver-haired angel was curious after what he said, "Show me too."
The two were chatting when one of the angels operating the starship below suddenly changed his expression: "Captain, enemy attack!"
The silver-haired angel glanced over there nonchalantly, without even putting down the red wine in his hand: "Where did that little guy come from again? Haven't those star giants suffered enough?"
"No, it's not." The little angel's face turned pale, and even his voice trembled, "It's the Black Iron Castle!"
As he spoke, he was already shaking his hands and projecting the image detected by the instrument onto the public screen.
Under the background of the deep and quiet starry sky, a behemoth like a steel behemoth was rapidly approaching at a terrifying speed.
That's a huge fortress!
A dark fortress that was extremely familiar to all of them, the Castle of Black Iron!
Different from the situation when it was parked, the Black Iron Castle at this moment has put away its base, parking platform, and all unnecessary facilities, and opened huge bronze wings on the side, soaring rapidly in the starry sky like a huge starship carrier.
There was no sound in the picture, but the waves of energy surging around the behemoth, the twisted space cracks, and the background that almost turned into meteors and broken light fully demonstrated how terrifying its momentum was.
On the monitoring data nearby, the star distance numbers that were shortening crazily at a terrifying speed fully demonstrated how alarming the speed of the Black Iron Castle was at this moment.
"grass!"
The wine glass in the silver-haired angel's hand fell to the ground with a clang and broke.
Why didn't he know that the Black Iron Castle could actually be used as a battleship? ! The Black Iron Castle is made entirely of bronze, and its hardness is unparalleled. If it were to collide with it, how could his starship still do anything? !
In fact, you can't blame him for not knowing. In fact, even the Star Giant himself has almost forgotten the function of the Black Iron Castle. After all, the last time the Black Iron Castle used this function was millions of years ago. Probably only the Nat family, who have been stationed in the Black Iron Castle for generations, still remember the original usage of the Black Iron Castle.
And this is also the basic usage of all bronze battleships.
Unfortunately, he only knew now that it was too late.
Just when the silver-haired angel reacted, he yelled in anger and asked his men to change direction, trying to avoid the Black Iron Castle, the Black Iron Castle was already roaring through the void and crashing directly into it.
"Rumble~~!"
A deafening roar instantly echoed through the void.
The patrol starships of the God's Domain are considered to be of the highest technological level in the entire interstellar range, but in the face of the terrifying power of the Black Iron Castle, they were flattened and knocked away with almost no resistance.
The sharp bronze flanks cut across the starship, and the starship was cut in half almost instantly, as if it were made of paper.
The angels in the ship flew out in all directions, trying to gain a chance of survival in the chaos, but before they could fly even a few kilometers away, they were uncontrollably swept in by the wave of energy surging around the Black Iron Castle, and were soon torn into pieces by the violent energy.
In fact, the Black Iron Castle is not specifically for the God's Domain Patrol. It's strange that this patrol was unlucky and bumped into the route of the Black Iron Castle.
The huge black fortress roared past, like crushing an insignificant pebble, and continued to gallop forward without any pause.
When the energy turbulence gradually subsided, only the twisted and scattered remains of the warships were left on the spot, slowly drifting away, with no trace of their original appearance.
At this time, after continuously accelerating, the Black Iron Castle finally reached the outskirts of the guard restriction of the Key Keeper Star.
"Long~!"
"Rumble~~!"
Feeling the approaching power, the holy light shields arranged around the Key Keeper Star automatically unfolded layer by layer. The holy light shields stacked and intertwined like scales, turning into a sea of light.
This is composed of thirteen people in the divine domain
